description: Converts a bounded integer string between bases 2 through 36 using exact BigInt arithmetic. Inputs contain 1–4096 digits and must be valid in the source base. Optional bitWidth (1–4096) validates a bit pattern; signed=true requires a width and reads the source value as two’s complement. Unsigned is the default. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

bitWidth.description: Optional bit width; required when signed is true.

signed.description: Defaults to false. When true, interpret the fitting source bit pattern as two’s complement.

value.description: Digits 0–9/A–Z without prefix, sign or separators; valid in fromBase.

name: base_convert

outputSchema.description: Original normalized input, source and target bases, converted digits, exact decimal value and unsigned source value as decimal strings, plus width and signed-mode metadata.

title: Decimal to Hex Converter
